title: Not getting your LOIs accepted? my thoughts inside

content.text:
96

 Sara,
Understanding how to navigate buying another accounting firm can really empower you to accelerate your wealth and the life-time success trajectory of your business.
If you can master this, opportunities really open up: 
Avoid buying a business that is littered with landmines (and could make your life miserable and ruin all your plans)

You’ll be well-equipped to hit the ground running the day of closing on your business

You'll be on track to keep growing your business through acquisition in stride

You can fast forward the success of your business

Whether you're not sure how to evaluate a target's potential, or you're not sure what your financing options are and what you could even afford. Maybe you're further in and you want to know how to navigate your site visit. Maybe it’s that you’re buried, overwhelmed and lost in the diligence process. For a lot of my clients, I know I used to really get hung up on how to figure out what experts they need to hire.
Our goal is to bring order out of the chaos and avoid the common traps that derail so many people so that you can close on your deal quickly and painlessly (or GASP, cut ties and leave if it’s not the right fit).
A success story doesn’t always mean the deal goes through - sometimes success means you figured out what was wrong with the deal quickly and efficiently and move on fast.
So here’s our first step:

Recognize that no one can (or should) know the deal as well as you. It's not as much about hiring the right experts; sometimes, even in order to figure out who to hire, you need to become the expert.
I want you to feel like you are the expert in the room.
Sara Sharp
Partner
SK&S Law Group
PS When do accountants fall over? When they lose their balance.
